usb-c-charging.rationale: Port presence does not establish charging.

exact-bed-inventory.rationale: A complete exact-unit inventory contradicts the second double bed.

mixed-unit-inventory.rationale: Inventory applicability to the requested unit is unresolved.

branch-hours.rationale: Applicable closing time precedes the required time.

reimbursement-receipts.rationale: Receipts establish neither direct billing nor its refusal.

core-offline.rationale: Optional sync does not remove the core internet requirement.

included-parking.rationale: The applicable rate directly supports the requirement.

qualitative-noise.rationale: A qualitative description does not establish a numeric bound.

conflicting-bike-rules.rationale: Both applicable current claims must be preserved.
